login.title: Sign in to management
login.code_hint: The code in the authenticator app changes every 30 seconds.
login.enrol_intro: Management needs a second step: a code from an authenticator app on your phone. This is done once.
login.enrol_step_install: Install an authenticator app, for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
login.enrol_step_scan: In the app, add an account and scan this code.
login.enrol_step_code: Type the 6 digits the app shows.
login.enrol_qr_alt: QR code to add this account to the authenticator app
login.enrol_manual: If scanning does not work, type this key into the app instead:
login.enrol_reload_note: Opening this page again creates a new code. Use only the code shown now.
login.verify_intro: Open the authenticator app on your phone and type the code it shows.
login.lost_phone: Lost the phone with the app? Contact Ran to restore access.
login.other_account: Sign out and sign in with another account

errors.invalid: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.invalid_code: The code is incorrect or has expired. Type the code the app shows now.
errors.session_expired: The session has ended. Sign in again.

capacity.title: Calendar
capacity.orders_count: {count, plural, =0 {No orders.} one {One order.} other {# orders.}}
capacity.sentence_closed: The day is closed to new orders.
capacity.sentence_unpaid_oven: {unpaid} of the booked minutes are in orders not paid yet.
capacity.sentence_unpaid_work: {unpaid} of the booked minutes are in orders not paid yet.
capacity.day_not_set: No capacity is set for this day, so customers cannot order for it. Save minutes below to open it.
capacity.blackout_has_orders: {count, plural, one {There is one order on this day.} other {There are # orders on this day.}} Closing the day does not cancel them.
capacity.source_manual: Set by hand for this day. The weekly pattern does not change it.
capacity.reset_done: The day follows the weekly pattern again.
capacity.error_below_reserved: Orders already booked {oven} oven minutes and {work} work minutes on this day. The totals cannot go below that.
capacity.error_session: The session has ended. Sign in again.
capacity.error_no_pattern: There is no weekly pattern for this weekday yet.
capacity.pattern_empty: No weekly pattern yet. Until one is saved, only days set by hand are open.
capacity.pattern_explain: Saving writes these numbers into the coming days. Days you set by hand, and days whose orders already need more, stay as they are.
capacity.pattern_saved: The weekly pattern was saved. {written, plural, =0 {No day needed a change} one {One day was updated} other {# days were updated}} in the next {days} days.
capacity.pattern_kept_manual: {count, plural, one {One day set by hand stayed as it was.} other {# days set by hand stayed as they were.}}
capacity.pattern_kept_below: {count, plural, one {One day was not changed} other {# days were not changed}} because its orders already need more.
